task_context.problem_statement: Linda makes $10.00 an hour babysitting.  There is a $25.00 application fee for each college application she submits.  If she is applying to 6 colleges, how many hours will she need to babysit to cover the application fees?
task_context.reference_solution:
The application fee is $25.00 per college and she is applying to 6 colleges so that's 25*6 = $<<25*6=150.00>>150.00
She makes $10.00 an hour babysitting. Her application fees total $150.00 so she needs to work 150/10 = <<150/10=15>>15 hours to cover the cost
#### 15
